products.name: Arthur AI
products.note: Model monitoring and governance; bias mitigation; fairness metrics; compliance reporting

profile_text.body:
Arthur AI is a New York-based company that describes itself as providing a control plane for trustworthy enterprise AI, uniting security, finance, and engineering teams on a single platform. The company positions its product as model-, framework-, and use-case-agnostic, meaning it is designed to govern machine learning models, generative AI, and agentic systems within one environment. Its stated purpose is to close the gap between teams that govern AI and teams that build it, covering performance observability, guardrails, and governance across the full AI lifecycle.

The company's core platform, tracked under the AI Governance and Risk Management category, focuses on model monitoring, bias mitigation, fairness metrics, and compliance reporting. Arthur describes the platform as serving governance and security teams who need to discover and apply policies organization-wide, as well as engineering and product teams building along what it calls the Agent Development Lifecycle. One customer is quoted on the site saying Arthur would reduce their maintenance workload by 50 percent, and another noted that a first production model went from concept to implementation in a few hours.

The held facts on file include no litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations associated with Arthur AI at this time.
